newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - May 22.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - May 22.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
ICI Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it would combine its domestic vinyl and PVC business with Auseon to form a new joint venture. Auseon is wholly owned by Geon Co of the U.S.

The Australian reported speculation on Thursday that Burns Philp's share price had fallen to the point where it was vulnerable to a takeover bid, possibly by Goodman Fielder, who had looked at such a bid.

Qantas Airways Ltd said late on Wednesday the Industrial Relations Commission had granted its application to restrain workers from taking further industrial action over plans to introduce competitive tendering for some ground services at Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth airports. Qantas chief executive James Strong holds a news conference at 2.00 p.m. (0400 GMT), where he is expected to announce an Asian management reshuffle and a new advertising campaign.

Rothmans Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it expected a flat performance in the coming 12 months after earlier announcing a near doubling in net profit to A$94.73 million for the year to March 31, 1997. "The next 12 month we think will be flat. The market is static or in some decline," general manager Gary Krell told reporters after the company released its 1996/97 results. Earlier Rothmans also announced a A$1.00 per share special dividend.

Pasminco Ltd said on Wednesday that production had resumed at normal levels at its Elura zinc mine near Cobar, New South Wales. Remedial action to address pillar damage which occurred on April 30 has been completed, Pasminco said.

A takeover offer by Axiom Properties Ltd for Perth-based investment group Resource and Industry Ltd (RAI) was welcomed on Wednesday by R&I directors, RAI said. Axiom earlier on Wednesday said it was planning a bid, offering two fully paid shares in Axiom for every three R&I shares. R&I shareholders will also receive a total of 17 cents per share return of capital.
